item.title: Pinductor: learning POMDP world models from observations with language-model priors
item.description: An LLM proposes programs as hypotheses about the dynamics of a partially observable environment. A particle filter selects among them from observations alone. An interactive walkthrough of the NeurIPS 2026 paper.

item.title: Autotelic quality-diversity for discovering LLM sycophancy
item.description: A repertoire instead of a score: a loop that invents its own attacks and maps 164 tactics that make a local model give in.
